newsitem.title: USA: Shiva target of holders suit -- attorneys.
newsitem.headline: Shiva target of holders suit -- attorneys.

text.p: Attorneys for people who bought Shiva Corp's common stock during a six month period said Thursday it filed a lawsuit accusing the company of artificially inflating its stock price.
The attorneys said the lawsuit alleges the company misepresented the demand for its products, the strength of its technologies and its competitiveness and the trends in its business.
The attorneys said the suit also alleges the company filed false financial statements that contained inflated revenues, receivables, inventories and earnings.
The attorneys also alleged a Shiva director, named as a defendant, sold blocks of the company's stock at inflated prices for about $1.9 million.
The company said the suit was filed on behalf of people who purchased the stock between September 10, 1996 and March 31, 1997.
The company said the suit was filed in the United States District Court in Massachusetts.
Plaintiffs seek to recover damages and are represented by Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP, Schiffrin & Craig Ltd, Savett Frutkin Podell & Ryan PC and Moulton & Welburn.
